text:
maria: saw a latency spike on shared-gpu-pool-7 around 12:10UTC, p50 fine but tail jumped to ~1.6s for small requests :thinking_face:
kevin: any repro or trace id?
maria: putting top-line data — p99 trace ids attached in thread, and a quick flame link: https://perf-reports/sha/2765439999
runtime-bot: profiling summary for pool=shared-gpu-7 window=12:05-12:20UTC
runtime-bot: kernels switched to 'prefetch-v2' on 12:09:42 for alloc pattern long+short mixed; avg kernel switch latency 4ms, but observed KV cache churn + elevated memcpy
ash: quick note — we rolled out a prefetch heuristic tweak yesterday that biases prefetching when sequence length variance > 0.35 (PR #4021)
jordan: could be kernel selection thrash. when prefetch increases, kernels flip to quant-path and back for mixed frames, evicting KV slots. that would blow up tail for small requests that hit cache miss.
kevin: do we have per-tenant activity? noisy neighbor suspected?
maria: yes — one tenant (t-company-x) had a burst of long streaming sessions starting 12:08, concurrent sessions spiked x6 above baseline. their tokens are long and KV sets grew ~4x.
sre-ops: current per-tenant rate caps are applied at the admission layer but burst window is 30s — maybe too permissive. config is: ```
admission:
  per_tenant:
    burst_window_s: 30
    tokens_per_s: 2000
```
sre-ops: also observed their leases stayed pinned on pool-7 due to placement affinity, so they hammered the same GPU set.
ash: interesting — if kernel auto-switch triggers on sequence length distribution in the batcher, and burst brings many long sequences, batching heuristics may coalesce mixed batches causing kernel autoswitch within same batch lifespan.
kejvin: (typo) kevin: can we see batch composition around 12:09?
runtime-bot: sample batches attached (small excerpt): ```batch 11523: [short, short, short] -> kernel prefetch-v1
batch 11524: [short, long, short, long] -> switch prefetch-v2 -> kernel swap cost 3.8ms
batch 11525: [short, short] -> unexpected cache miss, KV evictions: 48
```
ash: evict count 48 in small batch is high — indicates global KV pressure. do we have per-tenant KV slot accounting?
jordan: not per-slot, only global per-gpu kv_slots_used metric. we can add soft-pinning per-tenant to avoid complete eviction of small-request KVs.
kevin: any perf regressions in the runtime after prefetch change?
ash: there was a 0.7% regression in tail p99 on mixed workloads in canary, but we scoped it as acceptable. looks like the regression interacts badly with highly skewed tenant activity.
maria: for mitigation, I did a quick patch on staging: reduce burst_window_s to 10, and added transient tenant kv_quota: ```admission.per_tenant.kv_quota_transient = 0.15```
maria: staging looked better — tail reduced to ~900ms for same synthetic burst.
sre-ops: we should throttle placement affinity too — allow spread when tenant concurrent sessions > 4. placement change proposed: ```placement:
  allow_spread_if_concurrency_gt: 4
```
jordan: longer-term: make kernel selection stable per-batch group: group by predicted seq_std and enforce uniform kernel choice or split batches by sequence class. also add a max-kv-slots-per-tenant soft limit with eviction priority lower than system-critical caches.
eph: (not present)
kevin: +1 to both. also add sampling trace on admission rejection and KV eviction to correlate tenant ids.
maria: created an incident runbook draft in the doc: https://docs/internal/noisy-tenant-runbook — includes steps: 1) identify top tenants by kv_slots, 2) reduce burst window, 3) adjust placement, 4) rollback prefetch if needed.
nash: actionable next steps: (a) roll forward kv_quota_transient to prod with 1h ramp, (b) revert prefetch-v2 on the specific pools affected for safety, (c) add batcher grouping by seq_std threshold.
sre-ops: can do (a) and (b) now. I'll coordinate waterfall deploys.
kevin: also add a Grafana panel for 'per-tenant kv_slots' (even if approximate) and alert when any tenant > 3x baseline.
maria: logging note — add tenant_id to kv_eviction log line: ```kv_evict tenant=t-company-x evicted=48 reason=kv_pressure pool=shared-gpu-7```
jordan: perf test idea: run mixed short/long qps with affinity and measure kernel flip rate and evictions. I'll script that.
nash: good. thanks all. I'll open a follow-up PR for batcher grouping and a temporary rollback if needed.
maria: thanks. looping in @kevin for postmortem and customers. :thumbsup:
kevin: will take lead on postmortem. assigning follow-ups in linear.
runtime-bot: incident closed? manual check required. schedule a 1h sync if needed.
kevin: let's do a 30m sync at 13:00UTC to validate telemetry and rollouts.
maria: ack.
